title: Employer Handbook — Quarterly Reports, Taxable Wages and Contribution Assessments
content:
## Liability and the duty to report

A registered account in the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts becomes active with the first quarter in which the employer pays covered wages, and that quarter is its liability start quarter. Every liable employer files a contribution and wage report for each calendar quarter. The report is due on the last day of the month after the quarter ends. Employees are counted on the reference day of each month, and employers at or above the electronic filing threshold file electronically.

## Status condition

A report is accepted only while the account status is registered, active, delinquent or inactive; a closed account takes no report. The status is the one in the Department's records for that account when the report is filed.

## Taxable wages and contributions

- **Taxable wages** are total wages less excess wages. The excess is each employee's wages above the taxable wage base, counted cumulatively over the calendar year.
- **Contributory employers.** An original report assesses contributions equal to the taxable wages multiplied by the contribution rate in force for that quarter's rate year, rounded to the cent.
- **Reimbursing employers.** The report assesses nothing; the employer's liability comes from reimbursement bills.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A contributory employer reports taxable wages of USD 38,500.00 for a quarter whose rate year carries a rate of 0.0270. The contributions assessed are 38,500.00 multiplied by 0.0270, which is USD 1,039.50.

## One original report per quarter; corrections

An original report is filed once per quarter; a correction is an amended report, which assesses only an increase in contributions or books a credit for a decrease. A quarter that already has an original or a final report on the account takes no second one; any later filing for that quarter is an amended report.

| Amended report shows | Effect |
|---|---|
| Higher taxable wages than before | Only the increase in contributions is assessed |
| Lower taxable wages than before | A credit is booked for the decrease |

**Hypothetical amendment.** The quarter above is amended to taxable wages of USD 40,000.00. Only the increase is assessed: USD 1,500.00 multiplied by 0.0270, that is USD 40.50. Had the amendment lowered taxable wages to USD 37,000.00, a credit of USD 40.50 would have been booked instead.

## Estimates for unfiled reports — former clause

The former clause "When a report is still unfiled the estimated assessment days after the due date, contributions are assessed on an estimate of the highest of the last four reported quarters' taxable wages times the uplift, replaced by the real figures when the report is filed." is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for estimated assessments.

superseded_clauses: When a report is still unfiled the estimated assessment days after the due date, contributions are assessed on an estimate of the highest of the last four reported quarters' taxable wages times the uplift, replaced by the real figures when the report is filed.
